moment_transform: A_h(z)=sum_(n>=0)a_n(h)z^n=sum_j w_j(h)/(1-y_j(h)z), y_j(h)=exp(-h lambda_j), initially near z=0
positive_measure_transform: if all Hankel cones are PSD and endpoint asymptotics force compact support, A_h(z)=integral(1-yz)^(-1)dmu_h(y), whose singular support is real
mesh_continuity: PSD for every positive rational h extends to every positive real h because each finite matrix depends continuously on h and the PSD cone is closed
bad_meshes: pole collisions exp(-h lambda_j)=exp(-h lambda_k) form a countable union of discrete h-sets after distinct lambda values are grouped
generic_mesh: outside the bad set each nonzero source residue exposes an individual pole, which positive-measure continuation forces real
phase_rigidity: if exp(-h lambda) is real for arbitrarily small positive generic h, continuity near 1 makes it positive and sin(h Im(lambda))=0 forces Im(lambda)=0
xi_consequence: for lambda=-(rho-1/2)^2, Im(lambda)=-2(1/2-beta)gamma; nonzero gamma then forces beta=1/2
acceptance_test: Establish locally uniform convergence of the grouped general-zero transform on one common continuation domain, prove each grouped residue is nonzero for generic small h, and identify its poles with those of the compact positive-measure transform.
